dev_notes: src/commands/write.mjs cmdRename. The old name comes from Feature#stateAt's renamedFrom, computed from the named entries in the history rather than stored.

history.name: Renaming a feature
history.description: The command ledger rename changes what a feature is called, and every document footnotes the name it went by before. A feature that existed before this release needs a reason: one bullet saying what it was called and why the name moved.

history.reason: Renaming a feature is no longer a command of its own. A badly chosen name is wording, and you edit it in .ledger/features/<id>.json; see “Editing the ledger by hand”. A name the product actually changed is recorded with ledger update --name, which carries the reason the reader is given. Every document still footnotes the previous name.
